description: The live CRS changelog has release headings with no titles.
input:
## 2026-09-22

### Changed

- Donor core contributions to multilateral organisations (`bi_multi = 2`) are
  excluded from bilateral flows, since they are also reported in Members' Total
  Use of the Multilateral System and would otherwise double count.

## 2026-08-20

### Added

- Dataset added to the graph.
